entities.name: Battambang Cathedral
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Cathedral of Battambang, or Cathedral of Our Lady of the Assumption, was a former Roman Catholic cathedral in Battambang, Cambodia. It was built during the French colonial government in Cambodia and was destroyed in 1975 by the Khmer Rouge.
